info.name: LeadsTracker — Slot Booking v2
info.description:
Multi-booking slots · Separate booking lifecycle · Patient-doctor chat
Base URLs:
  Slots:    {{baseUrl}}/slots
  Bookings: {{baseUrl}}/bookings
  Chats:    {{baseUrl}}/chats

query.description: Populate confirmed bookings on each slot

request.description: Returns all non-deleted slots for the company on a given date, sorted by startTime. Auto-expires past available slots. Add withBookings=true to see confirmed bookings nested inside each slot.
Same as above but each slot includes its confirmed bookings array.
Max 31 days. Great for calendar/agenda views.
maxBookingLimit defaults to 1 if omitted. endTime auto-calculated.

response.name: 409 — Duplicate time
response.body: { "message": "A slot at this time already exists for this date" }

request.description: Creates a slot that can hold up to 5 bookings simultaneously (e.g. group therapy).
Idempotent. Re-run skips existing slots.
Admin blocks an available slot.
Admin cancels the entire slot. Existing bookings must be cancelled separately.

response.name: 200 — Cancelled
response.body: { "message": "Slot cancelled. Notify patients with existing bookings separately.", "data": { "status": "cancelled" } }

request.description: Raises/lowers maxBookingLimit. If slot was FULL and limit is raised above currentBookings, status automatically flips back to available.
Only works on available/blocked slots with no active bookings.

response.name: 404 — Has bookings
response.body: { "message": "Slot not found or has active bookings" }

request.description: Soft-delete. Fails if currentBookings > 0.

response.name: 404 — Has bookings
response.body: { "message": "Slot not found or has active bookings (cancel them first)" }

query.description: available|blocked — omit for both. Never deletes slots with bookings.

request.description: Atomically books slot (increments currentBookings, flips to full if limit hit). createChat:true auto-opens a chat thread seeded with confirmation message.

response.name: 409 — Slot full
response.body: { "message": "Slot is full — no bookings can be added.", "status": "full" }

request.description: Only triggers 409 when maxBookingLimit is 1. With higher limit it succeeds until full.
Transactionally: cancels booking → decrements slot.currentBookings → if slot was full, flips back to available → closes chat thread.
Marks booking as completed and resolves chat thread. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Replace the issues array on an existing booking.
Inbox view. Messages array excluded for performance — use GET /:chatId for full thread.
Full thread with all non-deleted messages. Populates booking, slot and assignedTo.

response.name: 200 — Full thread

request.description: Only needed if createChat was false during booking. Returns 409 if chat already exists for this booking.

response.name: 409 — Already exists
response.body: { "message": "A chat already exists for this booking" }

request.description: Called by your WhatsApp Baileys handler when a patient sends a message. Increments unreadByDoctor.
Marks all patient messages as read; resets unreadByDoctor to 0.
status: open | closed | resolved
Soft-deletes a single message. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
